# D15, Figure 8 of the Raft paper (G3, I8, mutCommitOldTermByCount): a leader
# of term 3 whose log holds entry 2 of term 2 never commits it by counting
# the replicas that hold it; it commits once an entry of its own term is held
# by a majority, and entry 2 with it.
add-nodes 1 voters=1,2,3 term=2 log=1,2
----
ok

campaign 1 elect
----
ok

process-ready 1
----
> 1 handling Ready
  seq=1
  HardState term=3 vote=1 commit=0
  AfterSync:
    1->2 MsgVote term=3 logterm=2 index=2
    1->3 MsgVote term=3 logterm=2 index=2
  Membership 1@0 2@0 3@0

storage-done 1
----
> 1 storage done seq=1 through 0/0

step 1 type=MsgVoteResp from=2 term=3
----
ok

process-ready 1
----
> 1 handling Ready
  seq=2
  Entries:
    3/3 noop
  Messages:
    1->2 MsgApp term=3 logterm=2 index=2 [3/3 noop]
    1->3 MsgApp term=3 logterm=2 index=2 [3/3 noop]

storage-done 1
----
> 1 storage done seq=2 through 3/3

# Peer 2 holds entry 2 of term 2: with the leader, a majority holds it.
step 1 type=MsgAppResp from=2 term=3 index=2
----
ok

process-ready 1
----
> 1 handling Ready
  Messages:
    1->2 MsgApp term=3 logterm=2 index=2 [3/3 noop]

raft-state
----
1: leader term=3 vote=1 lead=1 commit=0 stable=3 last=3

# Peer 2 holds the leader's no-op of term 3: everything through it commits.
step 1 type=MsgAppResp from=2 term=3 index=3
----
ok

process-ready 1
----
> 1 handling Ready
  seq=3
  Commit 3
  Messages:
    1->2 MsgApp term=3 logterm=3 index=3 commit=3
  Apply:
    1/1 command "e1-t1"
    2/2 command "e2-t2"
    3/3 noop

raft-state
----
1: leader term=3 vote=1 lead=1 commit=3 stable=3 last=3
